thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — we have the Edge Deliverable site (site-42) scheduled for physical delivery tomorrow 08:00 PT. I'm starting a short sanity checklist here for the on-site handoff. Main goals: GPU pool readiness, network rules validated with customer firewall, air-gapped package verification, kube cluster join, and cost/region flags. pinging @maria @kai for gating items.

maria: I'll take GPU inventory and node health. planning to run `nvidia-smi -L` and `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` on each host. will post outputs.

kai: I'll own the airgap artifacts and seed. current bundle: `edge-seed-v2.3.tar.gz` signed by ops-delivery. checksum: `sha256:9f3a...c2b4`. I'll validate extraction and containerd images import flow.

jordana: I'll coordinate customer network validation with their infra contact (Chris). Need to confirm these outbound rules are allowed through their perimeter: TCP 443 (for registry mirror sync), 123 (NTP), 32400-32410 (internal health probes), and TCP 22 to the bastion only. Also confirm MTU & path MTU.

maria: Preliminary GPU check results:
- host edge-node-01: 4x A100 80GB, ECC ok, temps nominal. `nvidia-smi -L` -> "GPU 0: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB"
- host edge-node-02: 4x A100 80GB, one NVLink warning in dmesg (transient).
Action: plan to retest after reboot if warning persists.

kai: Airgap flow notes:
1) On bastion in customer site: copy seed bundle to `/opt/edge-seed`
2) run `./import-images.sh /opt/edge-seed/images/*.tar` (script will `ctr images import`)
3) populate certs: `scp certs/site-42.crt /etc/edge/certs/` and run `edgectl verify-certs`
I'll attach the signed manifest and the small importer script here.

ops-delivery: package signed and staged to the handoff bucket: s3://redwood-edge-handovers/site-42/edge-seed-v2.3.tar.gz (presigned link shared via secure email). Delivery ETA truck: 07:00 PT.

alex: For cluster join, use the ephemeral join token in 1Password path `redwood/site-42/join-token` (expires +12h). Use `kubeadm join` wrapped in our helper: `./join-helper --token-file /tmp/token --role worker`. Make sure kubelet config has `readOnlyPort: 0` changed back to default.

jordana: Customer firewall confirmed the following for acceptance test window (08:30-09:30 PT):
- inbound: only allowed from our public NAT on 52.18.9.12 to the bastion 22
- outbound: allowed to our mirror S3 endpoint on 443, and to internal NTP.
They will keep ephemeral access logs open for our engineers during the window.

maria: Post-join validations I'll run:
- `kubectl get nodes -o wide` (report GPU allocatable: `nvidia.com/gpu`)
- run the small perf pod: `kubectl run perf-test --image=redwood/edge-gpu-bench:latest -- gbench --duration=60` and collect p50/p95 on token generation.
If p95 > 120ms for single-token local bench we escalate.

kai: Cost/region flag: note that this edge site has a local supplier-backed warranty and will incur increased swap/maintenance premium. Roughly +8% OpEx vs our standard dedicated pool. I've posted the cost delta estimate in the handoff doc. Customer agreed to the premium in the contract.

sre-bot: SECURITY CHECK: missing KMS binding detected for `site-42-kms-key`. Recommendation: do not enable customer-data encryption until KMS binding completed. Ticket created: #INC-4891.

alex: Good call. @ops-delivery can you arrange KMS/HSM binding with customer's key admin before 07:00 PT? That is a hard blocker for private volume encryption.

ops-delivery: Confirmed — I've scheduled a 06:00 PT key-exchange call and will post the confirmation here. Also packaging final on-site runbook into `/handovers/site-42/runbook.md`.

maria: Quick network sanity commands for on-site techs: `ip route show`, `ethtool -k eth0`, `ss -tnlp | grep 443`, `curl -I https://mirror.internal.redwood.com/health` — if any returns non-200, hold rollout.

kai: Final note on air-gapped registry: after `ctr images import` run `ctr images ls | grep edge-gpu-bench` and ensure tags map to manifest. Also run `edgectl image-cache verify --all`. If any image is missing, we have a 30-min window to push fallback images from the bastion.

alex: OK — plan for tomorrow: 06:00 key-exchange; 07:00 on-site delivery; 07:30 boot & node power-on; 08:00 join + import; 08:30 acceptance perf test. If all green we trigger `ops-delivery` to hand over control to customer success. If any critical failure (GPU down, certificate mismatch, KMS failure) we roll back nodes to maintenance pool and escalate to Tier-2.

jordana: I'll be on call 07:15-09:45 PT. Ping me if network or firewall issues.

alex: Thank you — please post any blocking items here, and drop short single-line updates during the window. :white_check_mark:
